_comment: Where each Assets/RyanAssets path lives. Files keep their relative path under Packages/<package>/Runtime/. Layers: a package may only reference asmdefs in its own or a lower layer.

com.ryan.core.description: Foundation: core helpers, input, tweening, data service, network settings, shared declarations/requests/globals/components, world UI, command definitions, client effects, shaders.

com.ryan.ui.description: UI controls (Textbox, ListGrid, ButtonGrid, Autocomplete), prompts, game settings, client audio and the command bar UI.

com.ryan.networking.description: Backend authentication and login, client connection core and modules, server modules, and player levels.

com.ryan.gameframework.description: Server runner and features, characters, tools, items, combat, cameras, platformer mechanics, network manager prefabs and authoring tools that every universe builds on.

com.ryan.hud.description: In-game HUD prefabs: chat, top bar, player list, vote, spectate, stamina, toolbar, name tags, build menu, credits.

com.ryan.commands.description: Chat command framework: server command handlers and the client command console.
